description: This file implements Google Cloud Text-to-Speech services, including HTTP and streaming APIs, with support for Gemini-specific models and multi-speaker configurations. It defines classes for both HTTP and streaming TTS, handles credentials, and provides language and voice configuration functions.

classes.name: GoogleHttpTTSService
classes.description: Provides HTTP-based Google Cloud Text-to-Speech synthesis with SSML support, including voice customization and metrics.

classes.name: GoogleBaseTTSService
classes.description: Abstract base class for Google Cloud TTS streaming services, handling client creation and common logic.

classes.name: GoogleTTSService
classes.description: Implements Google Cloud streaming TTS with support for Chirp and Journey voices, with prompt and language configuration.

classes.name: GeminiTTSService
classes.description: Provides Gemini-specific TTS models with multi-speaker support, style prompts, and low-latency streaming.

methods.name: language_to_google_tts_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to Google TTS language code.

methods.name: language_to_gemini_tts_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to Gemini TTS language code.
